form.label: L2T - Logon Pivot Analysis
form.description: Interactive logon analysis with user and computer pivoting capabilities

search.query: index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | search event_id=4624 new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" new_logon_account_name!="LOCAL SERVICE" new_logon_account_name!="NETWORK SERVICE" | stats count by new_logon_account_name | sort new_logon_account_name

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Logon Type:\\\\t\\\\t\\\\t(?<logon_type>\d+)" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ | eval logon_description=case( logon_type=="2", "Interactive", logon_type=="3", "Network", logon_type=="4", "Batch", logon_type=="5", "Service", logon_type=="7", "Unlock", logon_type=="8", "Network Cleartext", logon_type=="9", "New Credentials", logon_type=="10", "Remote Interactive", logon_type=="11", "Cached Interactive", true(), "Other" ) | timechart span=1h count by logon_description

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Logon Type:\\\\t\\\\t\\\\t(?<logon_type>\d+)" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ | eval hour=strftime(_time, "%H") | eval day=strftime(_time, "%A") | stats count by day, hour | eval day_order=case( day=="Monday", 1, day=="Tuesday", 2, day=="Wednesday", 3, day=="Thursday", 4, day=="Friday", 5, day=="Saturday", 6, day=="Sunday", 7 ) | sort day_order, hour

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Domain:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_domain>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Logon Type:\\\\t\\\\t\\\\t(?<logon_type>\d+)" | rex field=message "Network Information:.*?Source Network Address:\\\\t(?<source_network_address>[^\\\\n]+)" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | eval full_username=if(new_logon_account_domain!="-", new_logon_account_domain + "\\" + new_logon_account_name, new_logon_account_name) | eval logon_description=case( logon_type=="2", "Interactive", logon_type=="3", "Network", logon_type=="10", "RDP", logon_type=="5", "Service", true(), "Other" ) | stats count, values(logon_description) as logon_types, values(source_network_address) as source_ips, earliest(_time) as first_logon, latest(_time) as last_logon by full_username, computer_name | eval first_logon=strftime(first_logon, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_logon=strftime(last_logon, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -count

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Logon Type:\\\\t\\\\t\\\\t(?<logon_type>\d+)" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ new_logon_account_name!="-" new_logon_account_name!="SYSTEM" new_logon_account_name!="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | stats count by computer_name, new_logon_account_name | eventstats sum(count) as host_total by computer_name | eval percentage=round((count/host_total)*100, 1) | sort computer_name, -count | head 50

index=host sourcetype="l2t:winevtx" | rex field=message "Computer Name: (?<computer_name>[^,\s\n]+)" | rex field=message "\[(?<event_id>\d+)\s" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_name>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "New Logon:.*?Account Domain:\\\\t\\\\t(?<new_logon_account_domain>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Logon Type:\\\\t\\\\t\\\\t(?<logon_type>\d+)" | rex field=message "Network Information:.*?Source Network Address:\\\\t(?<source_network_address>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Network Information:.*?Source Port:\\\\t\\\\t(?<source_port>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Network Information:\\\\n\\\\tWorkstation Name:\\\\t(?<workstation_name>[^\\\\n]*)" | rex field=message "Detailed Authentication Information:.*?Authentication Package:\\\\t(?<authentication_package>[^\\\\n]+)" | rex field=message "Process Information:.*?Process Name:\\\\t\\\\t(?<process_name>.+?)\\\\n" | search event_id=4624 computer_name=$hostFilter$ new_logon_account_name=$userFilter$ logon_type=$logonTypeFilter$ | eval logon_description=case( logon_type=="2", "Interactive", logon_type=="3", "Network", logon_type=="4", "Batch", logon_type=="5", "Service", logon_type=="7", "Unlock", logon_type=="8", "Network Cleartext", logon_type=="9", "New Credentials", logon_type=="10", "Remote Interactive", logon_type=="11", "Cached Interactive", true(), "Other (" + logon_type + ")" ) | eval full_username=if(new_logon_account_domain!="-", new_logon_account_domain + "\\" + new_logon_account_name, new_logon_account_name) | table datetime, computer_name, full_username, logon_description, source_network_address, workstation_name, authentication_package, process_name | sort -datetime
